services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: Y Personal Training is all about YOU - your health, your needs, your goals. Our friendly, certified personal trainers take time to understand your individual needs as they design an effective exercise routine just for you! One of the many benefits of Y membership is having access to affordable, friendly, and effective personal training. Join Now! All Y personal trainers have gone through rigorous exercise and safety certifications to ensure that your personalized program is not only effective, but safe. services.name: Swim Teams
services.desc: The Y started the practice of swim lessons over 160 years ago and has taught generations of families how to swim and be safe in the water. Our certified instructors teach progressive, skills-based lessons for all ages, focusing on water safety, swim readiness, stroke development, and developing a healthy approach to water and exercise. You must be a Y member to participate in Y swim lessons. CLICK HERE to learn more and join. Not sure which swim lesson is right for you or your child? View our swim lesson selector guide which helps you narrow down the options based on your current skills and comfort zone. You may also contact a Y FAMILY CENTER for a free swim assessment.
